'''April 2001 Smyrna tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Champions C&C, Smyrna, GA on 14 April 2001. [[Jonny Chu]] won it. It is known from Adam Drake's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2092">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-16-drake-wins-gq-buford-tourney-4-14-01d2092/ drake-wins-gq-buford-tourney-4-14-01], DeckTech (Adam "ADrake" Drake, 16 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-16-drake-wins-gq-buford-tourney-4-14-01d2092/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Champions C&C, Smyrna, GA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Jonny Chu]]
